§6Cutting Machine§f turns ingots into plates, which is the primary way to produce plates in Advanced Rocketry. Most high-tier recipes need plates, so this machine is foundational.

The multiblock is a 3x3x3 hollow cube with the controller block in the center. Place a Saw Blade Assembly in the inventory slot, feed in ingots via Item IO Circuit Boards, and get plates out the back. It runs at 1 plate per 2 seconds.

§cWARNING:§f The exposed saw blade damages nearby entities every 10 ticks. Keep your base animals away from this thing.

§ePS:§f A Diamond Saw Blade lasts 4x longer than Iron. Steel and titanium plate production here feeds the Lathe, Rolling Machine, and Precision Assembler.
